{{2025–26 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2025–26 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team''' represented [[Vanderbilt University]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by second-year head coach [[Mark Byington]], and played their home games at [[Memorial Gymnasium (Vanderbilt University)|Memorial Gymnasium]] located in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Commodores]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 20–13, 8–10 in [[2024–25 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]], to finish in a four way tied for 9th place. As No. 12 seed in the [[2025 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] they lost in the first round to [[2024–25 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 10 seed in the East Region, where they lost in the first round to [[2024–25 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]].
